summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed Form 6-K for May 2026, attaching unaudited interim financial statements for Q1 2026. The filing contains routine quarterly financial reporting with no change-of-control, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event. The financials show net income of C$60.2M vs loss year-ago, driven by a C$32.9M gain on warrant liability revaluation and C$28.0M income from discontinued operations. There is no announced transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring. As a Canadian foreign private issuer, this 6-K is the equivalent of a domestic 10-Q and is purely a periodic financial update.
